household.load_error_description: Check your connection and try again.

selection.title: Choose a household
selection.description: Each household keeps its accounts and transactions separate.

creation.title: Create your household
creation.description: It will group the accounts and transactions you want to track together.
creation.name: Household name
creation.currency_help: Used by every account in this household.
creation.timezone_help: Detected from this device and used for calendar dates.

error.generic: The household could not be created. Check your connection and try again.
error.name_invalid: The household name must contain between 1 and 100 characters.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Review account balances and how they are grouped.
accounts.load_error_description: Check your connection and try again.

empty.title: Add your first account
empty.description: Accounts connect your balances and transactions to your household’s net worth.

creation.title: Add an account
creation.description: Add a balance source to your household. You can update its balance later.
creation.name: Account name
creation.balance_help: Enter the balance as of the selected date.
creation.load_error_description: Check your connection and try again.

error.generic: The account could not be created. Check the values and try again.
error.name_invalid: The account name must contain between 1 and 100 characters.
error.institution_invalid: Select a valid institution or no institution.
error.balance_invalid: Enter a valid amount with up to four decimal places.
error.date_future: The balance date cannot be in the future.

detail.balance_explanation: This amount includes transactions recorded after the latest declared balance.
detail.no_declared_balance: No balance has been declared yet.
detail.no_transactions: No transaction has been recorded for this account.
detail.load_error_description: Check your connection and try again.

edit.title: Edit account
edit.description: Update the information used to identify and classify this account.
edit.name: Account name
edit.kind_help: The type remains in the same asset or liability family.

error.generic: The account could not be updated. Check the values and try again.
error.name_invalid: The account name must contain between 1 and 100 characters.
error.institution_invalid: Select a valid institution or no institution.

balance.title: Update balance
balance.description: Enter the balance observed today to add a new reconciliation point.
balance.amount_help: Enter the amount observed on the selected date.
balance.date_help: This date must be after the latest balance on {date}.
balance.currency_help: Inherited from the account and cannot be changed.
balance.explanation: A new reconciliation point will be added to the history. Transactions recorded after this date will be included in the current balance.

correction.title: Correct balance
correction.description: Correct the amount or date of this balance in the history.
correction.explanation: The correction keeps the balance’s original source. If the date of the latest reconciliation changes, the current balance may change.

error.generic: The balance could not be saved. Check the values and try again.
error.amount_invalid: Enter a valid amount with up to four decimal places.
error.date_future: The balance date cannot be in the future.
error.date_not_after_latest: The date must be after the latest declared balance.
error.duplicate_date: A balance already exists for this account on that date.
error.not_found: This balance could not be found. Refresh the account page before trying again.

archive_list.title: Archived accounts
archive_list.description: These accounts are excluded from current net worth. View their history or restore them to use them again.

empty.title: No archived accounts
empty.description: Accounts you archive will remain available here with their transactions and balance history.

archive.title: Archive account
archive.requirement: The current balance must be zero to archive this account. Its history will be kept.
archive.conservation: The account will be removed from current net worth and from account choices for new transactions. Its transactions and balances will be kept. You can restore it at any time.

error.balance_not_zero: This account’s current balance is no longer zero. Close this dialog and refresh the account before trying again.
error.generic: The account could not be archived. Check your connection and try again.

restore.description: This account is archived. Its history is still available. Restore it to edit its information or use it again.
restore.check_balance: The account is active again. Check its current balance and update it if necessary before using it again.
restore.error: The account could not be restored. Check your connection and try again.
